It also does not exercise inclusive duration endpoints, missing IDs, or rejection of a non-None cursor. Malformed JSON and invalid UTF-8 caption bodies are not covered by the committed tests. Independent offline probes confirmed the implementation currently handles these cases correctly, so this is not a release blocker.

Assert skip_download=True and download=False in the vlog fake as well.

notes: No must-fix issues found. Reviewed exactly the requested commit range; HEAD matched the review commit and the initial working tree was clean.

Caption priority PASS: youtube_vlog.py:13-20 selects manual ko, then automatic ko-orig, then automatic ko, requiring json3 and a URL. This agrees with reports/T0.md. No selected track or no parsed cues raises AdapterSkipped(no_ko_captions) at lines 70-81. Existing added tests cover empty cues, non-json3 tracks, ko-orig priority, and urlopen HTTP 403/429.

Parse errors PASS: youtube_vlog.py:72 does not swallow JSONDecodeError or UnicodeDecodeError; both propagate through line 78 and are ValueError subclasses counted by worker.py:189. Independent probes confirmed this. Actual yt-dlp urlopen HTTPError 403/429 is recognized by _blocked and converted to AdapterBlocked at youtube_vlog.py:75-77.

None information behavior: fetch at youtube_vlog.py:69 converts None to an empty mapping and consequently reports no_ko_captions. The worker marks it skipped without an attempt or parse error. list_page instead rejects None through youtube.py:68-69. The fetch behavior matches the approved T4 implementation sketch; recorded as a robustness caveat rather than a must-fix deviation.

Translated-track caveat (note only): youtube_vlog.py:14 accepts automatic_captions[ko] even when it is a translated track for a non-Korean video. It does not inspect source language or tlang. ko-orig wins when available, but this is not a Korean-original-language filter.

Documents PASS: youtube_vlog.py:85-90 emits one FetchedDoc per segment, integer start-end thread keys, all nine required src_meta keys, public access, empty comments, and channel_id as author_raw (with the plan-prescribed uploader_id fallback). worker.py:346-353 uses thread_key for distinct document IDs and hashes author_raw; worker.py:480-482 handles AdapterSkipped before document creation. Independent probes verified two segments yield distinct IDs and channel_id is passed to author_hash.
